subject: Re: PoC / Trial - RACI & next steps (ClearLake Health)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.inference>
To: Sarah Nguyen <s.nguyen@clearlakehealth.org>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@clearlakehealth.org>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-07-15T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: PoC / Trial - Recap + proposed success criteria (ClearLake)

Hi Sarah / Tom 

Great to meet you both this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we kick off the trial: 

Recap:
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for internal clinical search and summarization workflows (notes ingestion -> search -> extractive summary).
- Scope for PoC: ~50k documents, 3 concurrent analyst users, 2 query patterns (ad-hoc search, daily summarization).
- Timeline: 4 week trial (2 weeks ingest + 2 weeks evaluation), start target: Aug 3.

Proposed Success Criteria (attached spreadsheet):
1) Latency: 95th percentile response < 350ms for single-query search under target concurrency.
2) Throughput: sustain 3 concurrent analyst sessions with median token cost under $0.006/token by leveraging caching/batching.
3) Quality: >85% precision on the top-5 returned summaries vs. the review set (see evaluation plan tab).
4) Stability: no more than one outage event impacting >5 minutes during the trial.

Next steps + ownership (proposed):
- ClearLake: provide sample dataset slice (PII redacted) and names of infra owner + security contact (Sarah/Tom to confirm).
- Redwood: provision a dedicated trial instance, ingest pipeline template, and evaluation harness. 
- Timeline confirmation & procurement: procurement loop-in for access/terms.

I've attached a first draft of the RACI and success criteria. Lauren & Dev  can you weigh in on infra ownership details and whether the timeline is realistic from your side?

Thanks 
Marissa
Director, Solutions  Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.inference
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.inference>

Date: 2026-07-15T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PoC / Trial - Recap + proposed success criteria (ClearLake)

Thanks Marissa  good summary. A couple of clarifications and a proposed RACI (high level) inline: 

RACI (PoC trial) - high level:
- Product / Use-case owner (ClearLake): Sarah Nguyen (Product)  Responsible
- Technical / Infra owner (ClearLake): Tom Alvarez (Platform/Infra)  Accountable for access + network
- Security owner (ClearLake): procurement/security mailbox (Procurement Team)  Consulted for onboarding checklist
- Redwood Trial lead: Marissa Cole  Responsible for trial coordination and success criteria tracking
- Redwood Technical lead: Dev Patel  Responsible for infra provisioning, model selection, quantization profile and integration guide
- Stakeholder updates: Lauren Bishop  Consulted / Approver for go/no-go at end of trial

Notes / questions:
- Dev: we'll need confirmation on whether ClearLake wants a VPC peering option or a hosted isolated instance (VPC recommended given PHI sensitivity). If VPC, Tom  we need the network CIDR, approved egress rules and a contact for firewall exceptions.
- Success criteria: the precision threshold is fine; recommend adding an acceptance check for data residency and audit log access.
- Timeline: 4-week is tight but feasible if we get a data sample and procurement sign-off within next 10 business days.

I'll update the attached RACI doc with these notes. Happy to hop on a quick 20m call if that helps accelerate procurement sign-off.

- Lauren

Hi team  quick technical notes and what we need from ClearLake to meet the proposed timeline: 

What Redwood will deliver (pre-trial):
- Dedicated trial instance (hosted isolated tenant) or VPC option (both viable).
- Ingest pipeline templates (S3-compatible or secure upload) and a small ETL script to map fields.
- Evaluation harness + scripts (we'll provide the test set + scoring script).

What we need from ClearLake (ASAP):
1) Data sample: ~2k de-identified documents (s3 link or secure upload).
2) Infra contact & access method: if VPC peering, provide CIDR, peering request form, and firewall owner. If hosted, provide approved IP allowlist.
3) Security questionnaire initial answers (we can accept a partial checklist to start).

Network & ownership notes (RACI specifics):
- Infra provisioning (Redwood)  Dev Patel (Redwood) will provision, but Tom Alvarez (ClearLake) is Accountable for network connectivity and approvals.
- App integration (ClearLake)  Sarah Nguyen Responsible for mapping analyst workflows and providing sample queries/labels.
- Security/compliance (ClearLake)  Procurement Team to provide data handling constraints and KMS requirements.

Proposed short timeline if we get items above by Jul 27:
- Jul 28-Aug 3: provisioning + ingest of sample corpus
- Aug 4-Aug 17: evaluation & signal collection
- Aug 18: go/no-go review and recommendation

If you prefer VPC peering, please confirm by EOD Tue (Jul 20) so we can reserve peering slots and start the network request.

Thanks 
Dev Patel
